steps.title: Analyze Retry Layout Coordinates Issue
steps.description: Inspected current GameView coordinate binding lifecycle to find why arrow locations remain reset on loading levels after retry events.

steps.title: Implement Dynamic Coords Recalculator
steps.description: Updated GameView's setGameEngine method to immediately force recalculation of dimensions if layout sizes are already present, ensuring immediate visibility on retry.

steps.title: Develop PCM Sound Synthesis Engine
steps.description: Created SoundManager with synthesizers using pure dynamic PCM data generated via AudioTrack to output tap sounds, explosion bleeps, and level wins without any binary dependency.

steps.title: Connect Sound Triggers in Game Logic
steps.description: Integrated launch tones inside triggerArrow, collision buzz inside update loop, and victory fanfare at complete level states.

steps.title: Validate Thread Safe Audio Execution
steps.description: Configured the sound system to run AudioTrack calculations in detached background threads to avoid blockages on main rendering steps.

steps.title: Review XML Layout Integrations
steps.description: Ensured the layout assets and custom GameView attributes align seamlessly under dynamic refresh activities.

steps.title: Confirm Proper Namespace Setup
steps.description: Verified correct XML schema namespace definition under AndroidManifest limits to prevent compile-time activity declaration exceptions.

steps.title: Audit Package Configuration Settings
steps.description: Set package consistency rules across app/build.gradle and app-meta configuration elements.

steps.title: Perform Java 8 Level Compilation Audits
steps.description: Checked compatibility standards of anonymous classes and verified zero lambdas usage in audio threads.

steps.title: Building Arrow Flow: Crash Course
steps.description: Trigger complete compilation task to bundle standard debug configuration binaries for device deployment.
